question: Which is the IUPAC group prefix of acyl halide compounds?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Halocarbonyl.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The IUPAC group prefix of acyl halide compounds is "Halocarbonyl."**
 
• **Acyl halides** are also known as acid halides, and they are compounds that contain a **carbonyl group (C=O) and a halogen atom (F, Cl, Br, or I)** attached to the same carbon atom.
 
• **Alkoxycarbonyl **is a group prefix used for compounds that contain an **ester functional group (RCOOR')** attached to an alkyl or aryl group.
 
• **Carbamoyl** is a group prefix used for compounds that contain a** carbamate functional group (NH2COOR')** attached to an alkyl or aryl group.
 
• **Cyano** is a group prefix used for compounds that contain a** nitrile functional group (CundefinedN) **attached to an alkyl or aryl group.
